decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of 'The Coast Is Clear'. The source documents explicitly identify two distinct albums with this title by different artists: Document 1 (D1S1) states it is the debut album by the band 'In-Flight Safety', and Document 2 (D2S1) states it is the fifth studio album by country artist 'Tracy Lawrence'. As different artists can legitimately release works with identical titles, both are valid answers corresponding to distinct referents found in the source text.
